inputs.text: It's nine P.M. You're still on the phone. Chasing crews, hours, receipts... and tomorrow's estimate isn't even started. Meet Orchamind. The AI brain that runs your field business. Just say it. Log eight hours for Mike at the Johnson job. Done. Add forty-two hundred in lumber to Oak Street. Done. Every morning, your briefing: what's at risk, who's where, what's over budget. Snap a photo of the plans, and get an itemized estimate, with good, better, and best options. GPS time clock. Client portal. Change orders that actually get billed. One flat price. Unlimited seats. First month free. Orchamind. Run the job, not the chaos.
